title: Had 2 issues.
text: Had 2 issues.. This would be a beautiful table runner but I have two issues with it. The 1st 1 is on the white part that is no printing there is a snag in the material so it looks like there's a big hard knot in it. The only way to remove that would be to cut it which I will not do. Ⅱ issue is about a ' away from where that not is there is 2 blacks smears on the material that I hope will wash out. I don't know what it is it looks kind of like a machine grease. I was really disappointed with these 2 issues because everything else on this runner is beautiful. The material is nice and thick ,not thin and flimsy. The printing and colors are beautiful and bright.
